q: After 12 hours motoring into a rough sea, the panel shows this and the revs start to hunt. What do you do?
answer: Switch to the clean side — the filter is clogging
why: Rising vacuum across the primary filter means it is blocking: a rough sea stirs up tank sludge and diesel bug. Change over, renew it.

lines: Filter vacuum, inHg: 2 at the start
Duplex primary filter, standby side clean

ru.Filter vacuum, inHg: 2 at the start: Разрежение, дюйм рт. ст.: на выходе 2

q: Over the last few weeks the engine has run hotter at cruising revs. You have already checked these. What is the most likely cause?
answer: Scale or impeller debris blocking the heat-exchanger tubes
why: Strong raw-water flow and full coolant point to poor heat transfer: scaled or blocked heat-exchanger tubes. Rod or descale them.

lines: Normal at these revs 82°; coolant tank full
Strong flow at the exhaust; new impeller

ru.Normal at these revs 82°; coolant tank f: Обычно на этих оборотах 82°; бачок полон
ru.Strong flow at the exhaust; new impeller: Сильный поток из выхлопа; крыльчатка новая

q: On passage the engine starts doing this. What is the most likely fault?
answer: A failed head gasket or a cracked head
why: White, sweet-smelling smoke with coolant loss and bubbles in the header tank means coolant is reaching the cylinders: the head gasket.

lines: Steady white smoke with a sweet smell
Coolant down a litre a day; bubbles in tank

ru.Steady white smoke with a sweet smell: Ровный белый дым со сладким запахом
ru.Coolant down a litre a day; bubbles in t: Литр антифриза в сутки; в бачке пузыри

q: In a Force 8 you closed the engine-room vents to keep the spray out. Since then the panel shows this. What do you do?
answer: Open the vents — the engine is starved of air
why: A diesel needs a great deal of air: shut vents starve it, so it smokes black, loses revs and heats the room. Open them; trust the baffles.

lines: Vents shut against spray since 1600
Black smoke; engine room very hot

ru.Black smoke; engine room very hot: Чёрный дым; в машинном очень жарко

q: Cruising at 1,900 rpm, your twin-screw motor yacht's starboard engine starts to overheat. What is the most likely fault?
answer: The starboard intake is blocked outside the hull
why: A strainer below the waterline floods by itself even if the impeller dies; air in it that will not clear means the intake is blocked.

lines: Stbd seacock open; little exhaust water
Stbd strainer bowl half air, not refilling

ru.Stbd seacock open; little exhaust water: Прав. кингстон открыт; воды в выхлопе мало

q: The charger has been on for three hours. The crew say it is failing because the current keeps dropping. What is happening?
answer: Absorption — at 14.4 V the current falls as it fills
why: Bulk pushes full current up to the set voltage; absorption holds that voltage while the current tapers; float follows when nearly full.

lines: Bulk: 62 A until 14.4 V at 2 h 10 min
Now 3 h in; current still falling

ru.Bulk: 62 A until 14.4 V at 2 h 10 min: Основной: 62 А до 14,4 В за 2 ч 10 мин

q: Nine days into a passage, your watermaker shows this. What do you do?
answer: Divert the product overboard and clean the membrane
why: Rising salinity at normal pressure with clean prefilters means a fouled membrane: dump the product and clean it by the maker's routine.

lines: Day 1: 280 ppm · maker: drink under 500
Prefilters new; feed water clean

q: At 0140 the engine-room fire alarm sounds on your 24 m motor yacht. Before you pull the fixed system's release, what do you do?
answer: Stop engines, generator and fans, shut the flaps, count everyone out
why: Running engines and fans draw the agent out and feed air in; shut the space tight and make sure nobody is inside.

lines: Camera: flames by the starboard engine
Fixed clean-agent system, wheelhouse release

q: At 0130, 110 M offshore, the alternator belt breaks and there is no spare. The engine still runs. What do you keep switched on?
answer: Nav lights and the VHF; plot by DR and fixes on paper
why: With no charge, save the battery for what keeps you seen and heard — the lights and the radio; a paper plot needs no power.

lines: 30 h still to go
House bank only, no solar

ru.House bank only, no solar: Только бытовой банк, солнечных панелей нет

q: Your fixed system has fired by itself in the engine room, and both engines and the generator stopped at the same moment. The mate wants to restart the engines at once. What do you say?
answer: No — the shutdown is meant; wait the hold time, then check
why: The system stops engines and fans so they cannot draw the agent out; restart only after the hold time and a check.

lines: Shutdown relay tripped at discharge
Open sea, 100 M off, drifting
